objective: Search specifically for strategies that maximize exact full-hit incidence, independently from ROI-oriented tournaments.

promotion.researchSignal: At least one exact full hit in locked validation or holdout, with model frozen before that segment is opened.
promotion.prospectiveCandidate: A research signal whose exact model and ticket-generation policy are sealed before future draws.
promotion.realMoney: Never from a full hit alone; requires the existing financial, statistical, bankroll and prospective gates.
